title: Foundation Pit Earth Excavation
problem_statement: Dig a 450 m³ foundation pit in dry clay under warm sunny weather. The machine is practically brand new (2 yrs old). Set your machine to finish in 58–60 minutes without wasting diesel.
learning_objective: Smart Mode gives full hydraulic power when digging clay without revving to maximum.

title: Deep Basement Dig in Hard Rocky Ground
problem_statement: Excavate 4 meters deep into hard shale on a hot sunny day. Heavy breakout force is required. Avoid excessive throttle to prevent hydraulic oil from boiling over.
learning_objective: Setting Boom Power priority directs hydraulic flow to the lift and stick cylinders for rocky breakout.

title: Wet Drainage Canal Excavation
problem_statement: Clear out a wet drainage canal during steady rain. Mud is heavy and slippery. High RPM will spin the tracks and cause canal banks to slide back into the trench.
learning_objective: Lower engine throttle in wet mud keeps tracks grounded and avoids canal wall cave-in.

title: Pipeline Earthmoving on Loose Sand
problem_statement: Move bulk sand along a pipeline corridor on a mild cloudy day. The excavator is brand new. Sand is easy to dig, so focus on fast swing cycles with Cat Grade Assist on.
learning_objective: Swing Priority speeds up the 90-degree swing cycle when casting loose sand.

title: Hillside Cut on an Aging Machine
problem_statement: Carve a bench on a steep windy slope with a 6-year-old excavator in cold weather. Hydraulic seals are stiff and older pumps will overheat if pushed continuously at max revs.
learning_objective: On an older machine in cold weather, steady throttle protects the hydraulic valves.

title: Wet Easement Utility Trenching
problem_statement: Trench 80 meters for underground electric conduit along a muddy roadside in the rain. Machine is 4 years old. Fast or jerky joystick moves will collapse the trench walls.
learning_objective: Soft Ground stabilizer stance spreads machine weight to prevent sinking into muddy ditch edges.

title: Tight Urban Fiber-Optic Trench
problem_statement: Dig a narrow 60cm wide trench between sidewalk curbs and utilities in the city. The machine is 2 years old. High precision is needed to avoid striking buried pipes.
learning_objective: Fine hydraulic speed prevents accidental jerking near live underground utilities.

title: Water Main Trench in Stony Ground
problem_statement: Dig a deep water main ditch through rocky gravel. The backhoe is 5 years old. Over-revving the engine will spin out the rear tires and cause excessive boom bounce.
learning_objective: Locked Down stabilizers absorb rock-breaking kickback without shaking the cab.

title: Stormwater Ditch Clearing After Storm
problem_statement: Clear out 100 meters of clogged stormwater ditch in heavy rain. The 6-year-old machine is on slick ground. Keep throttle gentle to prevent slipping down the embankment.
learning_objective: Gentle throttle and light bucket loads prevent tipping when working roadside embankments.

title: Suburban Sewer Line Connection
problem_statement: Connect a residential sewer branch line to the street main. Soil conditions are good and dry. Use steady boom controls to finish in ~39 minutes without over-digging.
learning_objective: Keep bucket fill around 85% to maintain trench grade accuracy without spilling.

title: Quarry Stockpile Truck Loading
problem_statement: Load 12 highway haul trucks with crushed limestone. Beginners often spin wheels and take 42 minutes. Turn on Auto-Dig and set smooth power to reach closer to 30 mins.
learning_objective: 80% Rimpull prevents wheel spin while pushing into crushed limestone stockpiles.

title: Rapid Sand Hopper Charging
problem_statement: Feed a concrete plant hopper with dry sand continuously. The loader is 2 years old and weather is warm. Fast V-cycles and snappy hydraulics will keep the hopper full.
learning_objective: Dry concrete ramp has high traction, allowing 100% Rimpull for maximum penetration force.

title: Wet Heavy Gravel in Slippery Yard
problem_statement: Load wet gravel onto flatbed haulers in a rain-soaked yard. Machine is 5 years old. Over-accelerating will dig deep ruts in the yard and ruin the loader tires.
learning_objective: 60% Rimpull cuts wheel torque just enough to stop wheel spin in slick wet yards.

title: Recycled Crushed Asphalt Shoveling
problem_statement: Transfer coarse milled asphalt into dump trucks under gusty winds. The loader is 4 years old. Maintain steady throttle and 90% bucket load to avoid asphalt spill on trucks.
learning_objective: Avoiding bucket overload prevents material spillage during windy high-lift dumps.

title: Railcar Bulk Aggregate Fast Loading
problem_statement: Load 6 rail hopper cars with heavy railway ballast. Brand new loader on firm concrete. Use Smart mode and fast hydraulics to finish within the 27–28 minute departure window.
learning_objective: Smart mode automatically delivers peak power only when the bucket penetrates the pile.

title: Highway Sub-Base Finish Grading
problem_statement: Smooth 1.2 km of highway base course to a tight ±5mm finish. Grader is 5 years old. High RPM or quick controls will cause blade bounce and ripples (washboarding).
learning_objective: 2nd Gear at 35-degree blade angle rolls windrows smoothly off the moldboard heel.

title: Airport Runway Foundation Precision Leveling
problem_statement: Grade a 500-meter aircraft apron slab foundation. Machine is 2 years old. Cat Grade technology must be ON to guarantee strict laser-flat grade across the entire runway width.
learning_objective: 1st Gear provides ultra-fine speed control required for sub-centimeter airport tolerances.

title: Stormwater Ditch Slope Shaping
problem_statement: Cut a clean V-drainage ditch along a highway during light rain. Machine is 6 years old. High blade resistance in wet dirt demands moderate RPM and fine moldboard tilt.
learning_objective: Deep Cut 45-degree blade angle carves steep ditch slopes without spilling dirt over the toe.

title: Logging Haul Road Heavy Regrading
problem_statement: Smooth out 3 km of heavy logging ruts. The grader is 7 years old with high hours. Don't push full throttle or the moldboard circle drive will overheat.
learning_objective: Pacing speed on an older grader preserves the moldboard circle drive on rough ruts.

title: Commercial Parking Lot Spreading & Crown
problem_statement: Spread dumped aggregate piles and establish a 2% slope for water runoff across a commercial lot. Good 3-year-old machine. Use Eco mode for steady blade spreading.
learning_objective: Spread 25-degree blade angle in 3rd gear casts loose material wide for rapid lot coverage.

title: Industrial Concrete Frame Demolition
problem_statement: Demolish a 2-story reinforced concrete building with a heavy hydraulic shear under gusty winds. Machine is 6 years old. Running max RPM in Power mode will overheat the hydraulic oil!
learning_objective: High Flow shear operation paired with 85% duty cycle keeps hydraulic oil temperatures in the safe green zone.

title: Bridge Pier Breaking with Hydraulic Hammer
problem_statement: Break down 4 reinforced concrete bridge piers using a high-impact hammer. The 4-year-old excavator needs steady hydraulic flow without hammer bouncing or dry-firing.
learning_objective: Low Flow breaker setting prevents pressure spikes while maintaining maximum impact frequency.

title: Confined Steel & Brick Mill Teardown
problem_statement: Tear down an old brick mill surrounded by live power lines in high winds. The 7-year-old excavator has noticeable boom lag. Avoid jerky swings to prevent falling debris hazards.
learning_objective: Paced 75% duty cycle on an aging demolition rig gives time for hydraulic oil cooling between cuts.

title: Foundation Slab Ripping in Wet Ground
problem_statement: Rip and lift a 30cm concrete warehouse floor in cold rain. Mud makes the heavy excavator slide during heavy prying. Keep throttle controlled and use ripper shank smoothly.
learning_objective: Avoid track slip when prying slabs: let the hydraulic cylinder do the work, not track spin.

title: Emergency Storm-Damaged Warehouse Clearing
problem_statement: Clear collapsed steel trusses and concrete walls after a storm. The machine is 8 years old (elderly fleet unit). Operating in Power mode will cause severe engine heat and seal blowouts.
learning_objective: Elderly machines must be operated at moderate throttle to prevent catastrophic hydraulic seal failure.
